WITH site_averages AS (
  SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat, AVG(m.facetfaces) AS avg_faces
  FROM sites AS s
  JOIN scanmesh AS m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat
), status_averages AS (
  SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_faces) AS avg_status_faces
  FROM site_averages
  WHERE entrystat IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY entrystat
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(facetfaces) AS avg_faces
  FROM scanmesh AS m
  JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = m.zoneref
), above_status AS (
  SELECT sa.avg_faces, sta.avg_status_faces
  FROM site_averages AS sa
  JOIN status_averages AS sta ON sta.entrystat = sa.entrystat
  WHERE sa.avg_faces > sta.avg_status_faces
)
SELECT AVG(a.avg_faces) AS average_face_count,
       AVG(a.avg_faces - o.avg_faces) AS average_above_overall,
       AVG(a.avg_faces - a.avg_status_faces) AS average_above_status
FROM above_status AS a
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o
WHERE o.avg_faces IS NOT NULL;
